name: AN IOU
source:
Trevor just moved to the city and is determined to become a successful artist... or die trying.
When he meets Mallory in his college art class, his life is changed forever.

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2052140/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
特雷弗刚刚搬到这座城市，决心成为一名成功的艺术家……否则就会死去。
当他在大学艺术课上遇到马洛里时，他的生活永远改变了。

[来自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2052140/]Steam[/url]]
